lines.en: label sarabar30:
if saraspecial30p2 == True:
scene movienight1
: Well, I’ll be damned. If it ain’t Captain Fucksalot.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真是活见鬼。这不是「操遍全场船长」吗。

lines.en: : I’ll take that over Douchebag McDouchefuck.
lines.zh: : 总比「混蛋·麦克混蛋操」好听。

lines.en: : Glad you’re conscious again. But if you think I’m gonna apologize for pullin’ you off of Sara-
lines.zh: : 很高兴你又醒过来了。不过你要是以为我会为把你从 Sara 身上拽下来而道歉——

lines.en: : I don’t think that at all. In fact, I’m glad you pulled me off. I...wasn’t really myself that night.
lines.zh: : 我一点都没那么想。事实上，我很高兴你把我拽了下来。那天晚上……我不是我自己。

lines.en: scene movienight2
I find Yuki alone at the counter after making my way into the bar. And if I focus just on her, I can help myself relive the moments back when this was all a hidden gem.
lines.zh: 走进酒吧，我发现 Yuki 一个人待在吧台边。只要我把注意力全放在她身上，就能帮自己重温那段这地方还是个隐藏宝地的时光。

lines.en: I tune out the chatter behind me and stare straight ahead, hoping that the person I came here to see will creep into my peripheral vision, but it’s all to no avail.
lines.zh: 我把身后的谈话声屏蔽掉，直直地盯着前方，希望我来这儿要见的那个人会溜进我的余光里，可一切都是徒劳。

lines.en: I know she isn’t coming.
lines.zh: 我知道她不会来。

lines.en: It’s not some paranormal sensation based on an unworldly connection and the fresh knowledge that we’re both prone to snapping from time to time — it’s just a hunch.
lines.zh: 这不是什么超自然的感觉，也不是基于某种超凡的联结、外加我俩都动不动就会崩溃的新鲜认知——只是一个直觉。

lines.en: A normal, old hunch.
lines.zh: 一个普普通通的直觉。

lines.en: And like a plant, I’ll let it die.
lines.zh: 而像一株植物那样，我会让它枯死。

lines.en: Because I can go one night without progression when there are others who need it more.
lines.zh: 因为还有更需要进展的人，我可以空一晚不推进任何事。

lines.en: : We cool then? No hard feelings from getting choked out?
lines.zh: : 那我们算和好了？被勒晕那事你不记恨吧？

lines.en: : No hard feelings. You’re a good friend.
lines.zh: : 不记恨。你是个好朋友。

lines.en: : To you? Or Sara?
lines.zh: : 对你？还是对 Sara？

lines.en: : To both of us. You helped in more ways than you know.
lines.zh: : 对我们两个都是。你帮的忙比你知道的多得多。

lines.en: scene movienight3
: All I did was bust into the living room and knock you out. Ain’t really what I’d call bein’ helpful.
lines.zh: : 我干的不过就是冲进客厅把你打晕。这可真算不上什么帮忙。

lines.en: : Well, it was.
lines.zh: : 不，就是。

lines.en: : And maybe next time, if all of us are conscious, you can help out in {i}another{/i} way.
lines.zh: : 而且下次，要是我们都还清醒着，你也许可以用{i}另一种{/i}方式帮忙。

lines.en: scene movienight4
: Or I can just choke you again.
lines.zh: : 或者我再把你勒晕一次。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay...too soon.
lines.zh: : 好吧……说太早了。

lines.en: : I’ll try again another night...
lines.zh: : 我改天再试……

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: else:
scene hungryboy
help
lines.zh: help

lines.en: scene black
scene movienight5
: Welp, now that that’s over, Tom Hardy or Leonardo DiCaprio? You have to pick one.
lines.zh: : 好啦，既然那事过去了，Tom Hardy 还是 Leonardo DiCaprio？你必须选一个。

lines.en: : Leo 100%%. It’s ridiculous that you even have to ask.
lines.zh: : 100%% 选 Leo。你居然还要问，太荒谬了。

lines.en: scene movienight6
: I don’t know. I feel like I might have to go with Tom on this. I like the whole tough guy thing, and he makes the beard work way better than Leo does.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这次我可能得选 Tom。我喜欢那种硬汉范儿，而且他留胡子比 Leo 好看多了。

lines.en: : Plus, watching Leo crawl out of a bear is going to stay with me forever and I don’t want that memory popping back up in bed.
lines.zh: : 再说，看 Leo 从熊肚子里爬出来那幕会跟着我一辈子，我可不想在床上又想起来。

lines.en: : Also, I wouldn’t have to worry about Tom Hardy just staring into the mirror during sex and that would totally be a Leo thing.
lines.zh: : 而且我也用不着担心 Tom Hardy 做爱的时候只顾着盯镜子——那绝对是 Leo 会干的事。

lines.en: : I’d stare into the mirror too if my name was Leonardo DiCaprio.
lines.zh: : 我要是叫 Leonardo DiCaprio，我也会盯着镜子看。

lines.en: : I think we’re a little too old for him now anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得我们现在对他来说有点太老了。

lines.en: : Maybe you, but I’ll be 18 forever.
lines.zh: : 也许你吧，可我永远 18 岁。

lines.en: : I...didn’t like either of them...
lines.zh: : 我……两个都不喜欢……

lines.en: scene movienight7
: You didn’t like Leo?! I was in love with him when I was your age!
lines.zh: : 你居然不喜欢 Leo？！我在你这个年纪可是爱死他了！

lines.en: : You were also pregnant when you were her age, so I think we should let Sana make her own decisions here instead of just following in your footsteps.
lines.zh: : 你在她这个年纪也怀孕了，所以我觉得这种事该让 Sana 自己决定，而不是跟着你的脚步走。

lines.en: : What didn’t you like?! Was it the beard? Because Haruka’s right, he looks better without the beard.
lines.zh: : 你到底不喜欢哪里？！是胡子吗？因为 Haruka 说得对，他刮了胡子更好看。

lines.en: : He’s...old. They’re both old...
lines.zh: : 他……太老了。他们两个都老……

lines.en: : Sana, I love you. But you are hurting me right now.
lines.zh: : Sana，我爱你。可你现在正在伤害我。

lines.en: : What even {i}is{/i} your type, Sana? I don’t think I’ve ever even heard you talk about boys before.
lines.zh: : Sana，你{i}到底{/i}喜欢什么类型？我好像从没听你聊过男孩子。

lines.en: scene movienight8
: Brendan Fraser? Brad Pitt? Johnny Depp? Keanu? Kevin Spacey?
lines.zh: : Brendan Fraser？Brad Pitt？Johnny Depp？Keanu？Kevin Spacey？

lines.en: : You might have more luck if you shy away from the 90’s heartthrobs and-
lines.zh: : 你要是别老盯着九十年代的那些万人迷，说不定还能——

lines.en: scene movienight9
: {i}Kevin Spacey?{/i} Really?
lines.zh: : {i}Kevin Spacey？{/i}真的假的？

lines.en: : There’s just something about him, you know?
lines.zh: : 他身上就是有某种东西，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Not...really?
lines.zh: : 不……太懂？

lines.en: : Um...I...I don’t really know...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我……我也不太清楚……

lines.en: scene movienight10
: I haven’t really...thought much about it, but...umm...
lines.zh: : 我其实……没怎么想过，不过……嗯……

lines.en: : Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许……

lines.en: : Pedro...Pascal?...
lines.zh: : Pedro……Pascal？……

lines.en: scene movienight11
: Yeah...
scene movienight12
: Wait, isn’t he the same age as Leo though?
lines.zh: : 等等，他不是和 Leo 同岁吗？

lines.en: : I could have sworn I read a thing about late 40’s actors the other day and I’m, like...{i}pretty{/i} sure they’re both 48.
lines.zh: : 我前两天好像看过一篇讲快五十岁演员的文章，而且我……{i}挺{/i}确定他俩都是 48。

lines.en: : There is no way Pedro Pascal is 48. But there’s also no way Leo is 48, so whatever you read is wrong.
lines.zh: : Pedro Pascal 不可能是 48。可 Leo 也不可能是 48，所以你看的那篇是错的。

lines.en: : Like I said, I...haven’t really thought about it...I just...think he’s kind of...cool...
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我……没怎么想过……我只是……觉得他有点……酷……

lines.en: scene movienight13
: Should we watch something with him in it next? I still haven’t seen that movie with him and Nicolas Cage.
lines.zh: : 那下一部要不要看有他的片子？我还一直没看那部他和 Nicolas Cage 一起演的电影。

lines.en: : What’s that about?
lines.zh: : 那是讲什么的？

lines.en: : It’s a movie about Nicolas Cage where Nicolas Cage plays Nicolas Cage. Also, Pedro Pascal is there.
lines.zh: : 是一部讲 Nicolas Cage 的电影，Nicolas Cage 在里面演 Nicolas Cage。另外 Pedro Pascal 也在里面。

lines.en: : That is the single most Nicolas Cage movie I have ever heard of.
lines.zh: : 这是我听说过的最「Nicolas Cage」的一部 Nicolas Cage 电影。

lines.en: : I can...stay for one more, but...I have to call Ayane first...
lines.zh: : 我可以……再看一部，不过……我得先给 Ayane 打个电话……

lines.en: : I forgot to tell her I...didn’t have work tonight, so...she’ll probably be...wondering where I am...
lines.zh: : 我忘了告诉她我今晚……不用上班，所以……她大概会……在想我在哪儿……

lines.en: scene movienight14
: Okay, but make sure you tell her I love her and that I want her to come by the bar more often.
lines.zh: : 好，不过一定要转告她我爱她，还想让她多来酒吧。

lines.en: : Not going to...tell her that...
lines.zh: : 不会……转告她的……

lines.en: scene movienight15
: Ask her how she feels about Leo! Ayane will have my back! She’ll understand!
lines.zh: : 问问她对 Leo 怎么看！Ayane 会站我这边的！她会懂的！

lines.en: : Ayane...only has eyes for...Sensei, so...
lines.zh: : Ayane……眼里只有……Sensei，所以……

lines.en: : Leo doesn’t count! He’s an exception to every rule!
lines.zh: : Leo 不算！他是所有规则的例外！

lines.en: scene movienight16
: Hah...betrayed by my own daughter...
lines.zh: : 哈……被亲女儿背叛了……

lines.en: : You want another drink? I’m making one last run to the fridge now since it would be extremely disrespectful to Nicolas Cage if any of us get off the couch during one of his movies.
lines.zh: : 你还要一杯吗？我现在最后去一趟冰箱，因为在他任何一部电影里，我们谁从沙发上起来都是对 Nicolas Cage 极大的不敬。

lines.en: : I’m fine. Thanks, though.
lines.zh: : 我不用了。不过谢啦。

lines.en: : You sure? You might need it. This {i}is{/i} a Nicolas Cage movie after all.
lines.zh: : 确定？你可能会需要的。毕竟这{i}是{/i}部 Nicolas Cage 的电影。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m okay, Haru-chan.
lines.zh: : 我没事，Haru 酱。

lines.en: : Okaaaaay. But don’t say I didn’t warn you.
lines.zh: : 好——吧。不过别说我没提醒你。

lines.en: scene movienight17
: So...what’s going on? You never throw together movie night unless you’re feeling down.
lines.zh: : 那么……怎么了？你要不是心情不好，从来不会搞什么电影之夜。

lines.en: : Oh? Since when do {i}you{/i} pay attention to anyone other than yourself?
lines.zh: : 哦？{i}你{/i}什么时候开始关注自己以外的人了？

lines.en: : Since Masahiro died.
lines.zh: : 从 Masahiro 死后开始。

lines.en: scene movienight18
: Ugh...poor Maki. I can’t believe all they’d give her is a fucking phone call.
lines.zh: : 唉……可怜的 Maki。我真不敢相信他们只给了她一通该死的电话。

lines.en: : Yeah...But ever since then, I’ve been trying to be a better friend. Things don’t always have to be about me anymore.
lines.zh: : 是啊……可从那以后，我一直在努力当个更好的朋友。事情不一定要永远围着我转了。

lines.en: scene movienight19
: Because in the grand scheme of things, and this isn’t me bragging or boasting, I don’t have it all that bad.
lines.zh: : 因为从大局来看——这不是我在吹牛炫耀——我的处境其实没那么糟。

lines.en: : You two are the ones struggling, so I’m gonna do what I can to be there for you.
lines.zh: : 真正在挣扎的是你们两个，所以我要尽我所能陪在你们身边。

lines.en: scene movienight20
: Thank you, Haru-chan...but just because your problems aren’t the heaviest around doesn’t make them any less real.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Haru 酱……不过你的烦恼不是最沉重的，并不代表它们就不真实。

lines.en: : I know how lonely you are. So I’ll always be here if you need me as well.
lines.zh: : 我知道你有多寂寞。所以你需要我的时候，我也永远都在这儿。

lines.en: : Thanks, Sara. So...are we gonna talk about it? Or is this more of an “Ignore it and keep our minds off of stuff night?”
lines.zh: : 谢了，Sara。那么……我们要谈这个吗？还是今晚属于「别管它，把脑子岔开」那一类？

lines.en: scene movienight21
: You know me...which means you know what I’ll pick.
lines.zh: : 你了解我的……也就是说你知道我会选哪个。

lines.en: : “Ignore it and keep our minds off of stuff night” it is. Thankfully, we have the world’s most unhinged and weirdly talented actor to help us out with that.
lines.zh: : 那就是「别管它，把脑子岔开」之夜。还好，我们有全世界最疯癫、却又诡异得才华横溢的演员来帮忙。

lines.en: : So...what are you going to do when he gets back to Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 那么……他回 Kumon-mi 的时候你打算怎么办？

lines.en: scene movienight22
: Nic Cage is coming to Kumon-mi?! Why?! {i}How?{/i}
lines.zh: : Nic Cage 要来 Kumon-mi 了？！为什么？！{i}怎么会{/i}？

lines.en: : I’m talking about your husband, Haru-chan...If you want to help me keep my mind off of stuff, let me share what bits of happiness {i}you{/i} have.
lines.zh: : 我说的是你丈夫，Haru 酱……你要是真想帮我岔开脑子，就让我分享一点{i}你的{/i}幸福吧。

lines.en: scene movienight23
: Well, I know we won’t be going to see Nicolas Cage.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道我们不会去看 Nicolas Cage。

lines.en: : Haru-chan...
lines.zh: : Haru 酱……

lines.en: : I don’t know, Sara.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Sara。

lines.en: : It’s been so long at this point that I can barely even remember what he looks like.
lines.zh: : 已经过去这么久了，我几乎连他长什么样都记不清了。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. We both know that’s not true. Plus, I asked about it, so you can say whatever you want and it won’t come across as braggy.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。我俩都知道不是那么回事。而且是我问的，所以你想说什么都行，不会显得像在炫耀。

lines.en: : I’m being serious, though. Like, yeah, I have pictures and everything. And tons and tons of memories.
lines.zh: : 不过我是认真的。比如说，对，我有照片什么的。还有多得数不清的回忆。

lines.en: : But it’s been years. What if he looks different? I know {i}I’ve{/i} put on some weight since he left.
lines.zh: : 可都过去好几年了。万一他样子变了呢？我知道他走之后{i}我{/i}胖了一些。

lines.en: : Yeah but you’re lucky because all of your extra calories go right into your boobs and mine just make my thighs jiggle.
lines.zh: : 是没错，可你运气好，多出来的卡路里全长到胸上了，我的全长到大腿上，一动就抖。

lines.en: scene movienight24
: It’s just kind of weird being away from someone for so long and then having them waltz back into your life one day.
lines.zh: : 离开一个人那么久，然后某天他又大摇大摆地走回你的生活里，这感觉就是有点怪。

lines.en: : Like, things keep moving while they’re not here. I didn’t hit the pause button on life. I’ve actually done things while he’s been gone. And I’m sure it’s no different for him.
lines.zh: : 就好比，他们不在的时候事情还是在往前走。我又没给人生按下暂停键。他不在的这段时间里，我其实做了不少事。我相信他那边也一样。

lines.en: : But, like...what would {i}you{/i} do if Sana’s dad just suddenly came back into the picture after all this time away? It would be weird, right?
lines.zh: : 不过……要是 Sana 她爸在消失了这么久之后突然回来，{i}你{/i}会怎么办？会很怪吧？

lines.en: scene movienight25
: Of course. But that’s way different, Haru-chan.
lines.zh: : 当然怪。可那完全不一样，Haru 酱。

lines.en: : He walked out on me intentionally...and it’s been over a decade since then.
lines.zh: : 他是故意抛下我走掉的……而且从那以后已经过了十几年了。

lines.en: : For all I know, the guy went and started another family after that. There’s no way it {i}wouldn’t{/i} be weird for him to just suddenly reappear.
lines.zh: : 搞不好那家伙之后又去组建了另一个家庭。他要是突然重新出现，怎么{i}可能不{/i}怪。

lines.en: : You really have no idea where he went?
lines.zh: : 你真的一点都不知道他去了哪儿？

lines.en: scene movienight26
: You think I would have just sat around and done nothing if I {i}did{/i} know where he was? No way. I would have been on that dude for child support even harder than Leo was on that bear earlier.
lines.zh: : 我要是{i}知道{/i}他在哪儿，你觉得我会干坐着什么都不做吗？不可能。我追着他要抚养费的劲头，绝对比刚才 Leo 追着那头熊还猛。

lines.en: : Sorry, stupid question...The whole situation is just so bizarre to me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，问了个蠢问题……这整件事对我来说实在太离奇了。

lines.en: : That’s because you have a husband who actually loves you and not some douchebag who just pretends to.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你有个真心爱你的丈夫，而不是一个只会装样子的混蛋。

lines.en: scene movienight27
: I’m not as smart as you, Haruka. Doesn’t matter if it’s now or all the way back then, there are just stupid things I’ve done that you never would have.
lines.zh: : 我没你聪明，Haruka。不管是现在还是当时，我都干过一些你绝不会干的蠢事。

lines.en: : Maybe if you grew up in my shoes you wouldn’t have wound up as perfect and beautiful as you are today, but even saying that is probably just me trying to make myself feel better.
lines.zh: : 也许你要是长在我的处境里，就不会变成今天这么完美、这么漂亮了——不过连说这话，大概也只是我在让自己好过一点。

lines.en: : It’s all so obvious in hindsight.
lines.zh: : 事后想来，一切都那么明显。

lines.en: : The “not wanting to ever bring me around other people” thing I can understand since I was still in high school and he was a grown man-
lines.zh: : 「从不想把我带去见别人」这点我还能理解，毕竟当时我还在上高中，而他已经是个成年男人了——

lines.en: : But the constant disappearances...the way he’d stare off into the distance any time I’d try to bring up the future...the look on his face the first time I told him I was-
lines.zh: : 可他不停地消失……每次我试着提未来，他就会盯着远处发呆……还有我第一次告诉他我——时，他脸上的表情……

lines.en: scene movienight28
: The...first time I...told him I was...
lines.zh: : 我第一次……告诉他我……

lines.en: scene movienight29
scene movienight30
: Can you braid my hair?
lines.zh: : 你能帮我编头发吗？

lines.en: : Sara...
lines.zh: : Sara……

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: : Come here.
lines.zh: : 过来。

lines.en: scene movienight31
: Thank you, Haru-chan. I’m sorry for ruining everything again.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Haru 酱。抱歉我又把一切都毁了。

lines.en: : You have nothing to apologize for. I was actually hoping you’d ask.
lines.zh: : 你没什么好道歉的。其实我一直在盼着你开口。

lines.en: scene movienight32
: Plus, Nicolas Cage gets to see you with braids now. And...remind me, how many men have gotten to see that version of you again?
lines.zh: : 再说，现在 Nicolas Cage 能看到你扎辫子的样子了。对了……提醒我一下，又有几个男人见过你这个样子来着？

lines.en: : Haru-chan, I have made more bad decisions in my life than I am able to count. But even I know better than to let a man see me with braids.
lines.zh: : Haru 酱，我这辈子做的蠢决定多得数不清。但就算是我，也知道不能让男人看见我扎辫子的样子。

lines.en: scene movienight33
: Good...Then I can keep this part of you all to myself.
lines.zh: : 很好……那这一面的你就可以只归我一个人了。

lines.en: : Besides, we both know I’d treat you better than any man ever could in the first place.
lines.zh: : 再说，我俩都知道，我本来就比任何男人都会对你好。

lines.en: : You would. You and me should just get married.
lines.zh: : 你会的。干脆我俩结婚算了。

lines.en: : Not legal in Japan, sweetie.
lines.zh: : 在日本不合法哦，亲爱的。

lines.en: : I wish the world would accept our love.
lines.zh: : 真希望这个世界能接受我们的爱。

lines.en: scene movienight34
: Man, I wonder when the last time I did this was? I hope I remember how.
lines.zh: : 天，我上一次做这个是什么时候来着？希望我还记得怎么弄。

lines.en: : Your hair’s just as soft as always. Are you still using that shampoo from-
lines.zh: : 你的头发还是和以前一样软。你还在用那款洗发水——

lines.en: : I miss my son.
lines.zh: : 我想我儿子。

lines.en: scene movienight35
: Can I...
lines.zh: : 我能……

lines.en: : Talk about him for a little while?...
lines.zh: : 聊一会儿他吗？……

lines.en: : Sara...
lines.zh: : Sara……

lines.en: : S...Sorry...There was...something weird on...
lines.zh: : 对……对不起……刚才……沾了点奇怪的东西……

lines.en: scene movienight36
: Hey, baby...
lines.zh: : 嗨，宝贝……

lines.en: : What...What happened?...
lines.zh: : 怎么……怎么了？……

lines.en: : Nothing, baby...
lines.zh: : 没什么，宝贝……

lines.en: : But...you're...
: Do you want to help braid my hair?...
lines.zh: : 要不要来帮我编头发？……

lines.en: scene black
scene bedroom_night
When I make it back to my room, I think about her one more time.
lines.zh: 回到房间后，我又想起了她一次。

lines.en: It isn’t for long, and it isn’t particularly groundbreaking-
lines.zh: 时间不长，也算不上什么惊天动地的念头——

lines.en: But the thought goes something like this:
lines.zh: 只是那个念头大概是这样的：

lines.en: I hope she’s with her daughter.
lines.zh: 我希望她和她的女儿在一起。
